\paragraph{Bounded native builds of the released library.}
The native point uses the release's Lean~4.34.1, Mathlib
\texttt{d13f23b7} and eight matching dependency pins on phobos-vt.
Table~\ref{tab:modern-native-builds} separates compiler invocations from
budget interruptions and dependency-blocked modules. All points use an
8,192\,MiB native memory option and the requested Lean worker counts in the
table; these are not measured OS-thread counts or hard-RSS guarantees.
Preparation and already-warm prerequisite
caches lie outside the compiler clocks.

\begin{table*}[t]
\centering
\small
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{5pt}
\begin{tabular}{lrrrrrrrr}
\toprule
Point & \shortstack{Requested\\Lean workers} & \shortstack{Heartbeats\\(thousands)} & Invoked & Compile &
\shortstack{HB\\stop} & \shortstack{Wall\\stop} & Uninvoked &
\shortstack{Compiler-wall\\sum (s)} \\
\midrule
Seven-module baseline & 1 & 200 & 7 & 7 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 44.003 \\
Same seven, \texttt{--profile} & 1 & 200 & 7 & 7 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 44.499 \\
Expanded closure & 1 & 50 & 82 & 81 & 1 & 0 & 46 & 218.436 \\
Incremental completion & 1 & 100 & 47 & 47 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 102.649 \\
Wider closure & 1 & 100 & 109 & 108 & 0 & 1 & 62 & 724.589 \\
Grid, \texttt{--profile --stats} & 1 & 100 & 1 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 300.100 \\
Grid, unprofiled & 8 & 100 & 1 & 1 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 634.280 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\caption{Distinct bounded native-build points, not a homogeneous full-library
run. Compile means exit zero without a sorry warning, not full service
acceptance or transitive axiom closure. HB denotes heartbeat interruption.
The first two rows compile the same seven modules. The incremental row uses
81 retained dependency objects from the preceding 128-module attempt.
The wider row includes a 120-second self-wall interruption of Grid.
The last two rows are separate 300-second profiled one-worker and
1,200-second unprofiled eight-worker points; both worker request and wall
bound change. Heartbeats are the Lean option, not a cumulative group counter.
Uninvoked dependencies have no measured compiler time or native verdict.
Row clocks are not added to claim a fresh same-budget build or isolated
worker-configuration speedup.}
\label{tab:modern-native-builds}
\end{table*}

The first seven unchanged modules cover four preselected targets and use
\texttt{autoImplicit=false} with olean-only output. Baseline and profiled
CPU sums are 44.044 and 44.530 seconds. Their fixed baseline-then-profile
ordering gives a 0.496-second wall difference (1.13\%) and an 89.078-second
two-mode capture, not a randomized overhead estimate or population bound.
Compiler high-water RSS is 7.46\,GiB versus a one-second sampled tree peak
of 7.43\,GiB. Native cumulative profiler phases overlap and do not partition
wall time. This point cannot rescale the different version, budget and
execution boundary in Table~\ref{tab:profiler-diagnostic-limits}.

The expanded three-target closure stops at a \texttt{ProjectionCoordinates}
heartbeat diagnostic: 81 modules compile and 46 dependents are uninvoked.
The later 100,000-heartbeat point compiles those remaining 47 modules,
making all three endpoints available. It preserves the earlier failure
and uninvoked states rather than proving general budget/runtime monotonicity.
The respective capture clocks are 225.245 and 110.118 seconds; the expanded
point's combined sampled tree peaks at 11.87\,GiB, including the retained
old EPFL process. Its compiler user/system CPU sums are 187.020/31.291 seconds.

The wider point adds nine targets from the original 53-target frame and
one unweighted public repeated-text probe. Seven of the nine original
endpoints compile; at that point Grid blocks the other two and the extra probe.
Its capture takes 732.836 seconds and the combined sampled tree peaks at
12.20\,GiB, including retained EPFL work. Across these distinct points,
244 compiled objects and 14 frame endpoints are available. These are not
a completed frame, population cost estimate or homogeneous fresh build.

Grid's 1.82\,MB source uses 151.397 user-plus-system CPU seconds before
the unprofiled 120.094-second self-alarm, despite requested
\texttt{-j1}/\texttt{LEAN\_NUM\_THREADS=1}. A separate native
\texttt{--profile --stats} diagnostic is self-interrupted after
300.100 seconds, with 176.164 user and 196.607 system CPU seconds.
Its sampled combined tree peaks at 10.89\,GiB. The log contains one completed
import event and 491 completed over-threshold type-checking events, whose
reported durations sum to 176.426 seconds; the trailing event and final
statistics are incomplete. Coverage is partial and durations can overlap,
so this sum is not an exclusive fraction of the 300-second denominator.
The 690,504 minor faults, zero major faults and 24,778,976/127,174
voluntary/involuntary context switches do not isolate a tactic, syscall
or hardware cause. Neither the earlier 120-second clock nor the seven-module
1.13\% observation supplies this diagnostic's missing phases or overhead.

At a separate unprofiled eight-worker point with a 1,200-second self-wall
bound, Grid compiles in 634.280 seconds without a sorry warning and the
native process retires. User/system CPU totals are 399.934/440.563 seconds,
the combined sampled tree peaks at 12.24\,GiB, and the resulting object is
84,076,976 bytes. This does not retrospectively make the two earlier
interrupted points compiler successes. Worker configuration and wall bound
change together; the one-worker outcome at the longer bound is unobserved,
so these points establish neither an isolated worker effect nor a speedup.
The completed object also does not supply the remaining uninvoked target
or typed-probe results.

\paragraph{Typed metadata does not establish cache eligibility.}
A native reader inspects the earlier 135 serialized objects and finds
1,799 theorems, including 743 auxiliary-name declarations.
Native expression equality yields 601 auxiliary-type keys, or 604 groups
when ordered universe parameters and private-name status are included;
45 groups span modules. The five files containing that pilot's 45
\texttt{decide +kernel} occurrences have 45
\texttt{of\_decide\_eq\_true}-headed auxiliary proofs with distinct native
type keys. Thus this pilot demonstrates no merging of those 45 calls by
exact type equality. The blocked public probe has 16 repeated source
annotations under 16 namespaces; text equality and namespace differences
prove neither equality nor inequality of resolved types.
Failed/uninvoked calls and the large repeated-goal PlanarPacking/Ramsey
clusters are absent from the metadata pilot. Full imported axiom closure,
hidden dependencies, replay qualification and whole-corpus failure-cache
coverage remain unmeasured. Reading objects is not checking them again.
